1566155.sourceDescription:
## Features
- 2-piece Deadpool and Spider-Man bundle
- Distinct Marvel designs
- CE certified Spider-Man light

## Information
Bring Marvel character and colour to your display with this Deadpool and Spider Man infinity mirror light bundle. Featuring a compact 20cm Deadpool alongside a larger Spider Man, the pair creates a varied illuminated display for bedrooms, gaming spaces, shelves or Marvel collections. Deadpool features 51 multicolour SMD LEDs, reflected through the mirrored design to create the illusion of an endless tunnel of light. The light produces a bright static effect and is rechargeable via USB, with a discreet 1.5m clear lead cable for flexible placement around your space. The larger Spider Man infinity light provides a striking companion piece, combining multicoloured LED illumination with an eye catching mirrored effect. Constructed from acrylic, foam and metal, it produces a static 249 lumen light output and is mains powered with a generous 3m transparent lead cable. Deadpool is designed for indoor use, while the Spider Man light is IP44 rated for both indoor and outdoor use. Display the two Marvel characters together for a coordinated feature with contrasting heights, or position them separately to add colourful illuminated character throughout your home or seasonal display.

## Features
- LED Infinity Light Hanging Snowflake
- Illuminated by bright LED light
- Features an infinity mirror effect

## Information
Transform your holiday decor with this stunning snowflake infinity led light decoration. Infinity lights are a modern mirror effect using light to create an illusion of depth and a repeating light pattern. This simple yet mesmerising light up display is thin whilst creating this amazing 3D effect as you view the snowflake from different angles. Create a festive display and a talking point for all your family and guests. Suitable to be hung anywhere around your home such as the garden fence, above the fireplace or to create a dazzling window display to welcome visitors this year. Featuring an infinity mirror with white LEDs, this creates the never ending reflection of the snowflake when lit up. The decoration is mains operated with a generous 3m clear cable from product to plug. Quick and easy to set up, just simply peel the film off the mirror and plug in. Suitable for indoor use and sheltered outdoor use.
